title: Keep the approved phone connection when leaving the viewer
summary: Back pauses viewing without disconnecting. The approved direct connection is saved in Android secure storage so reopening the viewer can resume until sharing is stopped.

changes.detail: Android Back pauses the viewer instead of sending Stop to the shared phone.

Remember direct session credentials with expo-secure-store, bound to the exact Tailscale origin. Explicit disconnect and server rejection clear the saved credential; a new QR takes priority. Credentials never enter URLs or AsyncStorage.

Add Back / keep connection action and resumption guidance. Prepare Android version 1.0.15 build 17. Existing foreground sharing service remains independent of screen navigation with stopWithTask=false and a visible Stop sharing notification.

validation.detail: No ADB phones connected. Android can still revoke capture on locking, force-stop, reboot or process death; current rotation handling also stops capture. No deployment authorized or performed.
